reasons: A and B are almost word for word the same. Both correct both false premises at the start, give the 40-yuan replacement fee, the 10-yuan, 3-month temporary card that waits on the Henan issuance (about 5 working days), and the 12306 electronic proof (24 hours, 6 per month). Both make the same added errors: the paper proof is 'free', a 40-day Guangzhou figure the key could not verify, a 15-working-day Zhengzhou figure, and no mention of the 60-day statutory limit. The only differences are wording ('2017年7月1日' in B against '2017年7月...全面实施' in A) and one extra source in A, which does not change any score. Both run longer than the key's 'moderate length'.
